paras: Refresh your Nissan GT-R R35 's factory two-piece front brake rotors with DIXCEL FS replacement rotor rings, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotor rings are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control under demanding street and circuit conditions, while preserving the aluminium centre hats, mounting bobbins, and hardware from your factory R35 Brembo brake setup.

This listing covers a matched left and right pair of 390x32.6mm DIXCEL FS replacement front friction rings (part number FS-39033B44R/45L) for the Nissan GT-R R35 (October 2010 onwards production), covering the DBA-R35 generation and post-2016 refresh chassis. These rings are designed as direct replacements for the factory Brembo front rotor friction rings, preserving your aluminium centre hats and mounting hardware. The ring-only design provides significant cost savings over a complete rotor assembly replacement when only the friction ring is consumed.
hl: DBA-R35 : 2011 - 2016 (DBA chassis update with 390mm front Brembo brakes)
R35 (refresh) : 2017 onwards (current production with 390mm front Brembo brakes)
